nodes.title: Is the equity actually worth anything?
nodes.body: Unknown until I see strike price, preferences, and the last valuation. An open question, not a bet — left unset on purpose.

nodes.title: I am mostly running from my boss, not toward this
nodes.distillate_text: A claim about my own motive — uncomfortable, but it predicts regret if true, so it is worth testing honestly.
nodes.body: A hypothesis pointed at myself. Naming it as a testable claim beats letting it operate unexamined.

nodes.title: The new role grows me faster than staying
nodes.distillate_text: A claim I am asserting, held weakly: bigger scope hints at it, but I have no outside data yet.
nodes.body: This is a hypothesis — a position I can argue and test — not a fact. Its confidence should stay low until a gap closes.

nodes.title: Will the new manager actually be good?
nodes.body: No position — this is an unknown, not a claim. Backchannel two ex-reports to resolve it. Confidence stays unset until then: pretending to know is the trap.

nodes.title: Haven't spoken to anyone who left that company
nodes.distillate_text: The growth claim cannot earn confidence until this gap closes — no evidence, no promotion.
nodes.body: A blocker on the growth hypothesis. This is what keeps its confidence honestly low.

nodes.title: Backchannel the manager + get equity terms, then decide in 2 weeks
nodes.distillate_text: Do not decide yet. Resolve the two open questions, close the data gap, then choose with earned confidence.
nodes.body: The output of a good decision graph is sometimes "run these checks first," not a snap answer.

nodes.title: Take the new job, or stay?
nodes.distillate_text: A real fork. Separate what I am claiming from what I do not yet know — and do not force a confidence I have not earned.
nodes.body: Most bad decisions here come from treating an unknown as if it were settled. Sort each sub-node into claim vs. open question first.

nodes.title: Scope is genuinely bigger — lead of 6 vs. solo
nodes.distillate_text: The one concrete, checkable premise under "growth". Confirmed from the job description.
nodes.body: A Reason under the growth claim: the piece that is actually verified, holding up the piece that is not.

facets.name: reversibility
facets.distillate: Hard to undo — I would be burning the bridge.

facets.name: timeline
facets.distillate: They want an answer in two weeks.

captures.text: what would make me say no in 6 months? write it down now
